newsitem.title: USA: Photovoltaic power sought for Texas schools.
newsitem.headline: Photovoltaic power sought for Texas schools.

text.p: Central and South West Services Inc said it will seek proposals for the purchase of up to 160 kilowatts of new photovoltaic resources on behalf of Central Power and Light Co, West Texas Utilities Co and Southwestern Electric Power Co.
All of the companies are units of Central and South West Corp.
The company said it is seeking proposals for individual systems of four kilowatts each to be located on the roofs of up to 40 separate schools in the three utilities service territories.
